card_summary: TrueVisions NOW has chosen Bitmovin's Observability to enhance its video streaming capabilities. The action took place to improve real-time insights into video playback. The implementation of Bitmovin's Observability will provide TrueVisions NOW with microservices-based monitoring and analytics, enabling better scalability and data integrity in their cloud infrastructure, potentially reducing egress costs and improving workflow automation through API orchestration.
body_html:
Technical Analysis: Bitmovin’s Observability Solution Enhances TrueVisions NOW Video Streaming with Real-time Playback Insights

TrueVisions NOW, a leading video streaming service, has announced the integration of Bitmovin’s Observability solution to enhance its video streaming capabilities. This technology involves the use of real-time analytics and monitoring to provide insights into video playback, allowing for improved quality of service and reduced errors. The solution is built on a microservices architecture, utilizing Kubernetes for deployment and scalability.

Operational ROI

The integration of Bitmovin’s Observability solution is expected to save TrueVisions NOW significant operational costs by reducing the time spent on manual quality control and error detection. With real-time insights into video playback, the service can quickly identify and resolve issues, resulting in faster content delivery and improved customer satisfaction. This affects the workflow step of content preparation and delivery, where manual QC effort can be eliminated, and automated workflows can be optimized.

In comparison to the existing approach, the use of Bitmovin’s Observability solution changes the operational dynamics by providing a proactive approach to error detection and resolution. Instead of relying on manual monitoring and reactive measures, the solution enables TrueVisions NOW to take a proactive stance, reducing the likelihood of errors and improving overall service reliability. This, in turn, reduces operational overhead, lowers infrastructure costs, and enables the service to scale more efficiently.

Security & Integration

From an integration perspective, Bitmovin’s Observability solution is designed to fit seamlessly into TrueVisions NOW’s existing broadcast IT stack, utilizing Object Storage (S3) for data storage and API Orchestration for workflow automation. The solution is built on a secure and scalable architecture, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations, such as those related to data protection and privacy. The use of Kubernetes for deployment and scalability ensures that the solution can be easily integrated with other microservices, enabling a flexible and modular approach to workflow automation.

Engineering Takeaways

  • Deployment: The deployment of Bitmovin’s Observability solution requires a minimum of 4 CPU cores and 16 GB of RAM, with a recommended network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Additionally, the solution requires a compatible Object Storage (S3) system and a Kubernetes cluster for deployment and scalability.
  • Compatibility: The solution is compatible with SMPTE ST 2110-20 for ingest and NMOS IS-04 for discovery, ensuring seamless integration with existing broadcast systems. The solution also supports S3-compatible APIs for data storage and retrieval.
  • What to Watch: Engineers should track the upcoming updates to the S3 API, which are expected to introduce new features and enhancements for data storage and retrieval. This will enable TrueVisions NOW to further optimize its workflow automation and data management capabilities.

The integration of Bitmovin’s Observability solution signals a significant shift towards real-time analytics and monitoring in the video streaming industry, enabling services like TrueVisions NOW to improve their quality of service and reduce operational costs. Engineering teams should focus on optimizing their workflow automation and data management capabilities to take full advantage of this technology and stay ahead of the competition.

Analysis: Bitmovin's Observability supports ST 2110, enabling TrueVisions NOW to monitor video playback in real-time, optimizing bitrate and reducing latency for improved streaming quality.
